Recap:
Current understanding: Brain Cloud has an architectural foundation but no proven persistent product path. Phase 1 must validate the smallest end-to-end cloud knowledge loop without pulling identity, sync, Hive Mind, or frontend work forward. / A Brain client developer can create a cloud-native project, store one durable memory, retrieve it, and find it through keyword search. This proves the public API, persistence, revision, and search seams before broader platform investment.
Key decisions: appetite captured.
Unresolved risks or questions: there are still open questions to review.
Parked items: none.
Recommended next stage: Review recap and continue into the epic stage when ready.
